description: Walkthrough screen 2: investigate the failing test without changing anything.

responses.text: I'll start by reading the failing test and running it.
The empty-hash test fails. Let me find verify_password.

Found it. tests/test_login.py:29 expects verify_password() to reject a user with no stored password, but src/auth.py:17-18 returns True when the stored hash is empty, so any password is accepted for that account. The fix is to return False there. I haven't changed anything.
